## Check out my interview with
Dr. Philip Dieter.
WATCH NOW!
“Steven Hayes has demonstrated the kind of leadership and public service California needs at every level. From his local leadership as a Fire Captain, to his work representing firefighters through the IAFF, to serving on the board of the California Earthquake Authority, Steven understands the importance of preparedness, resilience, and keeping our communities safe. He has the experience, character, and commitment to lead, and I’m proud to endorse him for Morgan Hill City Council.”
### – Senator Alex Padilla
Dear District B voters,
I have exciting news! After close consultation with my family and friends, I have decided to run for City Council.
Morgan Hill deserves a councilmember who has the vision and experience to turn ideas into action. Someone who can collaborate with other elected officials, city staff and community members to implement a positive future for our great city.
As a Fire Captain and tactical paramedic, I’ve spent my professional life putting others first, solving problems under intense pressure, and showing up when people need help the most. I know firsthand how strong leadership, thoughtful planning, and compassionate decision-making can make a real difference in people’s lives.
I want to ensure that our city remains safe; our neighborhoods and parks are advocated for, businesses can prosper, our youth have opportunities to be successful, and families can thrive here. I’m enthusiastic about creating solutions to the many issues that impact our community and the next generation of residents.
Frankly, I’m not a career politician, who is only interested in the next political move. I’m running because I want to bring my experience, work ethic, and commitment to service to represent you on the City Council—not for politics, but to make Morgan Hill the best it can be for everyone who calls it home.
I’m excited, humbled, and ready to do the challenging work for our community. I respectfully ask for your vote.
Sincerely,
Steven Hayes II

# Endorsements
Steven is a man of unmatched integrity. He’s a true servant leader, a reliable friend, and someone I trust with my life. Steven brings both character and expertise. He understands the municipal government inside and out and has built relationships with key stakeholders in Sacramento that will directly benefit our community. He leads with honesty, listens with empathy, and acts with accountability.
– Veronica Andrade, Morgan

As a lifelong resident of Morgan Hill and San Martin, I care about South County and the direction it is headed. I’ve known Steven Hayes for over 20 years. He’s a level-headed, common-sense kind of guy. He is who we need to serve on the City Council in Morgan Hill. I have endorsed Steven and contributed to his campaign. I am proud to wholeheartedly endorse Steven Hayes for Morgan Hill City Council. Steven is a man of integrity, strong character, and genuine dedication to our community. He leads with honesty, listens to others, and truly cares about making Morgan Hill a better place for everyone.
I trust Steven to serve with fairness, wisdom, and accountability. He has my full support, and I encourage my friends, neighbors, business owners, and fellow residents to join me in voting for Steven Hayes. Our community deserves leaders like him.
